name: whatsapp-counts
description: Counts reported in a WhatsApp field group live in the first number of each message
claim: This is a WhatsApp group chat export, one row per message: "sender", "message" (often Hinglish), "first_number" = the first small number written in the message (e.g. "total 29 bacche aaye" -> 29), "media" = photo/file placeholder. Counts reported in chat live in first_number; filter by words in message (e.g. bacche, aaye, update).
